scorer: A1 E05, A3 E00 identity coefficients; no retraining or A2 retuning
candidate_audit: Retain old lemma/POS measurement. Record additions, removals, unchanged IDs and changes to retained candidate content. Label-mismatching additions are not automatically grammatical errors.
selection: Opt-in experimental combined repair only if focused positive/negative contracts pass, historical inputs remain unchanged, baseline is reproduced, both splits have no net lemma/POS or feature loss and no increase in wrong committed lemma decisions. Do not promote the historical default.
public_outputs: New implementation, tests, protocol, aggregate report, hashes and backup receipts. Full source corpus rows and model weights remain local/on V.
